method: Read builder equivalence fingerprint, then independently reconcile every candidate audit form/gloss/exportedNotes/exportedtags/district and original citation against its actual proposal row. Validate every alternate target after aliases, every historic key stays its own representative, all candidate mappings retain source locators. No builder execution or canonical writes.

coverage.literal_gloss: How far is it from here to Kashmir?

coverage.literal_form: Nina gāun ūṭaḷi yaddan gōgā igadgā?
coverage.literal_gloss: How many sons are there in your father's house?
I have walked a long way to-day.

coverage.literal_form: Nān kākan gōvank āun tāngśi puḷi śendū
coverage.literal_gloss: The son of my uncle is married to his sister.

coverage.literal_form: Ā ūṭaḷi vāḷa khudryād khōgir igada
coverage.literal_gloss: In the house is the saddle of the white horse.
Put the saddle upon his back.

coverage.literal_form: Āun gāunk nā lahāv ṯs̱ābūk iḍnē
coverage.literal_gloss: I have beaten his son with many stripes.
He is grazing cattle on the top of the hill.
He is sitting on a horse under that tree.

coverage.literal_form: Āun tembi tān tāṅgśi kita vāsk igarū
coverage.literal_gloss: His brother is taller than his sister.
The price of that is two rupees and a half.

coverage.literal_form: Nān gāv ā chiṭ ūṭaḷi nikyākū
coverage.literal_gloss: My father lives in that small house.

coverage.literal_form: Āunk nallā iḍḍ ān kharguṭā kaṭṭa
coverage.literal_gloss: Beat him well and bind him with ropes.
From whom did you buy that?
From a shopkeeper of the village.

limitations: This confirms no encoded lexical/semantic/district distinction is lost by reuse, not that identical form/gloss/district attestations prove historical lexeme identity. They share an entry with every original citation and keyed audit occurrence retained.
Source-key identity is preserved; no database/public-ID rebuild run.
Report pins the inspected proposal; changed lexical inputs require renewed mapping checks.
